title: Debut Features by Great Directors
intro: Every legend had a first film and some of them arrived fully formed and utterly fearless. These six debuts carry the fingerprints of giants.

films.title: Following
films.line: A lonely man trails strangers through London until obsession quietly consumes him whole.

films.title: Bottle Rocket
films.line: Three lovable dreamers stumble through a heist that was never going to go to plan.

films.title: Reservoir Dogs
films.line: The aftermath of a diamond heist unravels in a room full of liars and loaded guns.

films.title: Bad Taste
films.line: A scraggly alien invasion arrives in a small town and chaos bleeds into pure strange genius.

films.title: Pi
films.line: A mathematician chases a pattern hidden inside numbers until the universe starts chasing him back.

films.title: Eraserhead
films.line: A man tends to his strange child in a world that feels like a fever you cannot shake.
